sonnet.problem: The statement that the envoys came from a distant land, from Babylon, re-asks a fact the earlier cards already told. Cards 1, 3 and 5 all say the envoys are from Babylon. The question therefore gives its own answer and tests nothing new.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
